stories.title: Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct to get a health and wellbeing hub
stories.summary: A health and wellbeing hub is to open in Mold town centre, part-funded by a Welsh Government regeneration grant. The hub is being set up by Hughes Pharmacy. It has received capital funding through the Welsh Government’s Transforming Towns programme, which Flintshire County Council’s regeneration team administers. stories.title: NRW urges people across Wales to ‘Be Flood Ready’
stories.summary: Following a summer marked by drought and wildfires Natural Resources Wales (NRW) is urging people across Wales not to become complacent about flood risk this autumn and winter. Communities across Wales experienced devastating flooding and storms last winter, before prolonged dry conditions, drought and significant wildfires affected many parts of the country during the summer.

stories.title: Estimates say routine flu vaccination would have prevented 800 hospital admissions in Wales last winter
stories.summary: Routine flu vaccination is estimated to have prevented more than 800 flu-related hospital admissions in Wales last winter. Public Health Wales estimates that, without vaccination, 50 per cent more people would have been admitted to hospital.
